requirements.description: The user prefers the unit to be located near parks. Per the data distribution, 'near' maps to the 75th percentile (74.26), rounded to 74. Parks are explicitly requested, so the green category is activated.
User prefers energy class D or better, so all classes from A1 to D are included. This is a preference, so it is stated as a requirement for ranking rather than a hard constraint on the other filters.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: commercial property type, surface_area >= 115, a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy_class in A1–D, and green >= 74. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates. No LIMIT and no comune_code predicate, since the place name was not supplied as coordinates.
